value.title: Request body ownership with BodyState and BodyAlreadyConsumedException

acceptanceCriteria.text: `BodyAlreadyConsumedException` is a public class in `com.snoworca.naruserve` extending `RuntimeException`. [D-086; wave decision: Body ownership]

`BodyState` is an internal class whose state is `UNREAD` initially, `PARSING` while a reader holds the body, and `CONSUMED` after a completed read or `CLOSED` after the body was closed; a unit test drives each transition. [D-085] Decision: `close` moves to `CLOSED` from any state, and a later `begin` or shared parse throws `BodyAlreadyConsumedException`. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-3-4 SDS-AC-11] User-approved revision: FR-DX-007 permits cached same-Type JSON reads, including cached null; mixed formats, mismatched types and retries after failed parsing remain rejected.

A unit test acquiring the body through `BodyState` after a first read gets `BodyAlreadyConsumedException` when the second read is of a different kind (JSON, form/multipart or raw) or is a second JSON or raw read; the shared form/multipart parse of AC-4 is the only exemption. [D-086] Decision: `begin` in any state other than `UNREAD` throws `BodyAlreadyConsumedException` naming the current state. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-3-4 SDS-AC-9] User-approved revision: FR-DX-007 permits cached same-Type JSON reads, including cached null; mixed formats, mismatched types and retries after failed parsing remain rejected.

A unit test acquiring the shared form/multipart parse through `BodyState` repeatedly gets the same parse result each time without a second read of the stream and without `BodyAlreadyConsumedException`. [D-087] Decision: the shared parse after `begin`, or `begin` after the shared parse, throws `BodyAlreadyConsumedException`; a parser failure leaves `CONSUMED` with no cached result and later calls throw `BodyAlreadyConsumedException`. [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-3-4 SDS-AC-10] User-approved revision: FR-DX-007 permits cached same-Type JSON reads, including cached null; mixed formats, mismatched types and retries after failed parsing remain rejected.
A reflection test finds no public body-reading method on `Request` at the wave 3 merge (wave 5 adds the body readers). [wave decision: Body ownership]

value.requirement: The system shall consume a request body stream once, cache a successful JSON result (including null) for repeated reads of an equal Type, and share one form parse across form/file/files/parts. Different JSON types, mixed body formats, closed requests and retries after parsing failure throw BodyAlreadyConsumedException.
value.rationale: Covers D-085, D-086, D-087 and the wave decision on body ownership (W2-004; I-012). The JSON, form, multipart and raw readers arrive in waves 5 and 6, so wave 3 tests these rules through `BodyState` directly; the raw kind is an internal consumer of the body stream.
